verdict.rationale: Visual scripting is a fair question for a game engine like Babylon.js, so the axis applies. The pack only documents the Node Material Editor, a visual shader editor, which is an adjacent feature for materials rather than gameplay logic. It also mentions code-level 'actions' and 'behaviors' in the scene graph, but nothing shows a no-code visual scripting tool for gameplay.

support.subject: As a technical artist, I can build gameplay logic with visual scripting without writing code
